program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time }) { const launchSpeed = inputs.launchSpeed; const gravity = 9.8; const t = time; const height = launchSpeed * t - 0.5 * gravity * t * t; const velocity = launchSpeed - gravity * t; const apexTime = launchSpeed / gravity; const apexHeight = (launchSpeed * launchSpeed) / (2 * gravity); const scaleY = 30; const baseY = 360; const ballY = baseY - height * scaleY; const ballX = 320; const objects = []; objects.push(sdk.panel({ id: "lane.toss", x: 40, y: 40, w: 560, h: 360, title: "Vertical Toss Motion", state: t < apexTime ? "Moving up" : (Math.abs(velocity) < 0.1 ? "Still for an intermittent instant" : "Moving down") })); objects.push(sdk.axis("axis.height", { x: 80, y: 360, length: 300, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.5, ticks: [0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5], label: "Height", unit: "m" })); objects.push(sdk.groundMark("mark.launch", ballX, baseY, 60, "Launch mark")); objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.toss", ballX, ballY, 24, { role: "observed" })); objects.push(sdk.arrow("vec.v", ballX + 20, ballY, ballX + 20, ballY - velocity * 15, { role: "observed" })); objects.push(sdk.arrow("vec.a", ballX - 30, ballY, ballX - 30, ballY + 30, { role: "observed" })); const motionText = velocity > 0.1 ? "Moving up" : (Math.abs(velocity) <= 0.1 ? "Still for an instant" : "Moving down"); objects.push(sdk.callout(ballX + 45, ballY - 20, [motionText, "Gravity pulls down"])); return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects: objects, readouts: [{ id: "motionState", value: motionText }, { id: "gravityState", value: "Gravity pulls down" }] }, quantities: { launchSpeed: launchSpeed, gravity: gravity, apexTime: apexTime, apexHeight: apexHeight, velocity: velocity, height: height } }; }

manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: Gravity slows the ball on the way up and speeds it up on the way down. At the top, the ball is still for an instant while gravity pulls it downward.
manifest.description: An animation showing a tossed ball moving vertically on a height scale. A blue motion vector changes with velocity while a dashed warm gravity arrow remains constant.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed, then press Play. At the top, playback pauses so you can inspect the arrows.
